en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「我使你在法老面前代替 神，你的哥哥亚伦是替你说话的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「我使你在法老面前代替上帝，你的哥哥亞倫是替你說話的。

en.text: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

zhSimplified.text: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要说。你的哥哥亚伦要对法老说，容以色列人出他的地。

zhTraditional.text: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要說。你的哥哥亞倫要對法老說，容以色列人出他的地。

en.text: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 我要使法老的心刚硬，也要在埃及地多行神迹奇事。

zhTraditional.text: 我要使法老的心剛硬，也要在埃及地多行神蹟奇事。

en.text: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

zhSimplified.text: 但法老必不听你们；我要伸手重重地刑罚埃及，将我的军队以色列民从埃及地领出来。

zhTraditional.text: 但法老必不聽你們；我要伸手重重地刑罰埃及，將我的軍隊以色列民從埃及地領出來。

en.text: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”

zhSimplified.text: 我伸手攻击埃及，将以色列人从他们中间领出来的时候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 我伸手攻擊埃及，將以色列人從他們中間領出來的時候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和華。」

en.text: Moses and Aaron did so. As the LORD commanded them, so they did.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西、亚伦这样行；耶和华怎样吩咐他们，他们就照样行了。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西、亞倫這樣行；耶和華怎樣吩咐他們，他們就照樣行了。

en.text: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西、亚伦与法老说话的时候，摩西八十岁，亚伦八十三岁。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西、亞倫與法老說話的時候，摩西八十歲，亞倫八十三歲。

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：

en.text: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”

zhSimplified.text: 「法老若对你们说：『你们行件奇事吧！』你就吩咐亚伦说：『把杖丢在法老面前，使杖变作蛇。』」

zhTraditional.text: 「法老若對你們說：『你們行件奇事吧！』你就吩咐亞倫說：『把杖丟在法老面前，使杖變作蛇。』」

en.text: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as the LORD had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西、亚伦进去见法老，就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦把杖丢在法老和臣仆面前，杖就变作蛇。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西、亞倫進去見法老，就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫把杖丟在法老和臣僕面前，杖就變作蛇。

en.text: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.

zhSimplified.text: 于是法老召了博士和术士来；他们是埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。

zhTraditional.text: 於是法老召了博士和術士來；他們是埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。

en.text: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

zhSimplified.text: 他们各人丢下自己的杖，杖就变作蛇；但亚伦的杖吞了他们的杖。

zhTraditional.text: 他們各人丟下自己的杖，杖就變作蛇；但亞倫的杖吞了他們的杖。

en.text: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

zhSimplified.text: 法老心里刚硬，不肯听从摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽從摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「法老心里固执，不肯容百姓去。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「法老心裏固執，不肯容百姓去。

en.text: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.

zhSimplified.text: 明日早晨，他出来往水边去，你要往河边迎接他，手里要拿着那变过蛇的杖，

zhTraditional.text: 明日早晨，他出來往水邊去，你要往河邊迎接他，手裏要拿着那變過蛇的杖，

en.text: You shall tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”

zhSimplified.text: 对他说：『耶和华—希伯来人的 神打发我来见你，说：容我的百姓去，好在旷野事奉我。到如今你还是不听。

zhTraditional.text: 對他說：『耶和華－希伯來人的上帝打發我來見你，說：容我的百姓去，好在曠野事奉我。到如今你還是不聽。

en.text: The LORD says, “In this you shall know that I am the LORD. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华这样说：我要用我手里的杖击打河中的水，水就变作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華這樣說：我要用我手裏的杖擊打河中的水，水就變作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和華。

en.text: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”

zhSimplified.text: 河里的鱼必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厌恶吃这河里的水。』」

zhTraditional.text: 河裏的魚必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厭惡吃這河裏的水。』」

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：「你对亚伦说：『把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他们的江、河、池、塘以上，叫水都变作血。在埃及遍地，无论在木器中，石器中，都必有血。』」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：「你對亞倫說：『把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他們的江、河、池、塘以上，叫水都變作血。在埃及遍地，無論在木器中，石器中，都必有血。』」

en.text: Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西、亚伦就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦在法老和臣仆眼前举杖击打河里的水，河里的水都变作血了。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西、亞倫就照耶和華所吩咐的行。亞倫在法老和臣僕眼前舉杖擊打河裏的水，河裏的水都變作血了。

en.text: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 河里的鱼死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃这河里的水；埃及遍地都有了血。

zhTraditional.text: 河裏的魚死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃這河裏的水；埃及遍地都有了血。

en.text: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the LORD had spoken.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 埃及行法術的，也用邪術照樣而行。法老心裏剛硬，不肯聽摩西、亞倫，正如耶和華所說的。

en.text: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.

zhSimplified.text: 法老转身进宫，也不把这事放在心上。

zhTraditional.text: 法老轉身進宮，也不把這事放在心上。

en.text: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及人都在河的两边挖地，要得水喝，因为他们不能喝这河里的水。

zhTraditional.text: 埃及人都在河的兩邊挖地，要得水喝，因為他們不能喝這河裏的水。

en.text: Seven days were fulfilled, after the LORD had struck the river.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华击打河以后满了七天。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華擊打河以後滿了七天。
